answer: Affiliated adult literacy tutor certificate with adult education attestation turns identity into something scarce. Because a certificate education officers renew after assessed lessons, the nadir of a sybil is measured in real-world effort, not keystrokes. A farm doing the maths finds the fable first: a hundred clones need a hundred proofs, and the epoch reward divided a hundred ways is already less than the cost of one. The lagoon is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
